homepage.coreValueTitle: Built for how Lebanon actually drives
homepage.coreValueIntro: Every part of TrackWay — the hardware, the software, and how we install it — is designed around one goal: total visibility over every vehicle, with zero guesswork.
homepage.coreValue1Desc: Teltonika-grade GPS hardware built for continuous operation, engineered to keep reporting even in weak-signal areas across Lebanon.
homepage.coreValue2Desc: A live dashboard that turns raw GPS data into geofences, alerts, reports, and trip history you can actually act on.
homepage.coreValue3Desc: Our team installs on your schedule, wherever your vehicles are — from a single private car to a full commercial fleet — with ongoing support.
homepage.industriesTitle: One platform, every kind of fleet
homepage.industriesFleetsDesc: Live location, route history, and geofence alerts across every vehicle in the fleet.
homepage.industriesRentalDesc: Know where every rental is, geofence approved zones, and get an instant alert if one leaves.
homepage.industriesDeliveryDesc: Real-time visibility per vehicle, with trip history and reports your dispatch team can act on.
homepage.industriesSchoolDesc: Live bus location for parents and administrators, with geofenced pickup and drop-off alerts.
homepage.industriesPrivateDesc: Affordable tracking and theft-recovery alerts for personal vehicles — no fleet minimum.
homepage.industriesConstructionDesc: Track machinery across job sites with geofence alerts for unauthorized movement.
homepage.servicesSubtitle: Every tool you need to monitor, protect, and optimise your vehicles — in one connected platform.
homepage.controlRoomTitle: Your fleet, watched over around the clock
homepage.controlRoomBody: Every vehicle reports its position, status, and alerts back to a single live view — so nothing moves without you knowing.
homepage.howItWorksTitle: From installation to insight in three steps
homepage.howItWorksNotice: Submitting a preferred date does not automatically confirm the appointment.
homepage.howItWorksStep1Desc: Tell us about your fleet and preferred installation date through our booking form.
homepage.howItWorksStep2Desc: Our team reaches out to confirm the details and schedule your installation.
homepage.howItWorksStep3Desc: We install your GPS hardware and walk you through your live dashboard.
homepage.finalCtaTitle: Ready to take control of your vehicles?
homepage.platformDemoSubtitle: TrackWay brings your fleet, drivers, and operations together in one connected view — live data, actionable insights, better control.
homepage.platformDemoPoint1Desc: Live tracking, instant alerts, and geofencing keep you in control of every move.
homepage.platformDemoPoint2Desc: Actionable insights and reports help you optimize performance and reduce operational costs.
homepage.platformDemoPoint3Desc: Safer drivers, efficient operations, and happier customers — every day.
